acceptance: The cache verification report exposes verified GitHub source identities, and pruning computes deterministic candidates by comparing those entries with the remote sources in an explicit lockfile.
aipo package cache prune <cache-dir> --lock <lockfile> is a dry-run by default, lists candidates and never mutates the cache; --apply is required for deletion.
Pruning refuses to delete when cache verification finds any invalid entry, rejects symlink/non-directory targets, and never removes entries referenced by the supplied lockfile.
The operation performs no network access, authentication, registry access or lockfile mutation and leaves unrelated cache entries untouched.
Positive and negative tests cover dry-run, apply, retained entries, corrupt caches, symlink targets, missing locks and CLI argument validation; documentation and full repository gates remain green.

non_goals: Automatic or time-based eviction without an explicit lockfile and apply mode
Deleting corrupt/unknown entries, repairing cache data or changing lockfiles
Network access, private repositories, authentication, registry publication or semver solving
Vendor directories, signatures, attestations, submodules and lifecycle execution

evidence.description: aipo-package default tests passed 49 cases and all-features tests passed 52 cases, including verified source reporting, unexpected-layout rejection, safe verified removal and existing cache graph behavior.

aipo-cli package integration tests passed 29 cases by default and 30 with github-http, covering prune dry-run/apply, referenced-entry retention, missing locks, corrupt-cache fail-closed behavior and existing package commands.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets and cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features passed on the final rerun; the default build remains free of ureq and no live GitHub test was used.

cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, cargo doc default/all-features, node selftest, cargo deny, cargo audit, prumo validate and prumo doctor all passed.
CLI reference, ADP-007, GitHub fetch security documentation, CHANGELOG and PROJECT_STATE now define lockfile-driven pruning, dry-run/apply semantics and verified-only deletion.
prumo tool scan-secrets crates, docs and .ai reported no secrets; git diff --check passed.
